acceptance_rule: Correctness, originality, and value must all pass.

correctness.rationale: The two-mode proof was reconstructed independently. In the orthonormal basis aligned with the first direction, the true second-direction curvature gives \(v^TAv=a\det A\) and the AOS model gives \(v^T\bar Bv=a(a^2+h^2)\); substituting a rotated two-eigenvalue matrix yields the displayed distortion. A separate symbolic recomputation of the diagonal family reproduced \(r=(\kappa^2+1)/(2\kappa)\), the exact objective ratios, and the \(\kappa/4\) asymptotic. The package verifier was inspected rather than treated as proof by log alone.
correctness.risks: The theorem concerns the first AOS step after exact initialization on a two-mode invariant subspace; it is not a global divergence result.

broader_coverage.evidence: Ni–Liu (2024) accessible abstract concerns a different Dai–Liao method; Liu (2026) asks whether CG_AOS converges theoretically.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Those results do not imply the exact distortion or sharp safeguard for the audited algorithm.
broader_coverage.search: approximately optimal stepsize Dai–Liao conjugate gradient 2024; Dai–Yuan Wolfe convergence

claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: The source defines the same AOS matrix but does not derive the two-mode theorem; standard Wolfe-based Dai–Yuan results assume line-search conditions not supplied by AOS.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: No checked prior implication mechanically yields the final claim.
claim_vs_prior_implication.search: source algorithm definition plus existing convergence results

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The audited formula is a local exact identity for the source CG_AOS model, not merely a generic nonlinear-CG convergence bound.
equivalent_formulations.search: CG_AOS, Dai–Yuan AOS, two-mode quadratic, overshoot, curvature distortion, damping

exact_database_or_table.reasoning: This is an analytic formula rather than a database lookup.
exact_database_or_table.search: published semantic corpus for CG_AOS transient amplification and sharp two-mode safeguards

originality.rationale: The exact two-mode distortion, sharp transient factor, explicit \(\kappa/4\) excursion family, and \(2/\kappa\) safeguard were not found in the source algorithm paper, the closest 2024 Dai–Liao/AOS paper, published-corpus searches, or semantic searches. The source algorithm paper explicitly leaves CG_AOS convergence/rates open. The 2024 paper's accessible abstract describes a different Dai–Liao parameter construction with descent/convergence under additional conditions rather than this CG_AOS step.
originality.residual_risks: The 2024 Dai–Liao paper full text was not available, so an unnoticed related local calculation remains a limited risk; its stated method and claims differ materially.

source_inspections.assessment: Same algorithm; no audited theorem; explicitly leaves theoretical convergence/rates open.
source_inspections.material_read: full HTML sections defining AOS/CG_AOS and the open-problem discussion

source_inspections.assessment: Different Dai–Liao parameter construction; residual comparison risk only.
source_inspections.material_read: publisher abstract and bibliographic page; full text not accessible in this run

value.rationale: The result identifies a sharp, condition-number-scale obstruction in a newly proposed CG stepsize whose global theory is explicitly open, and gives an exact safeguard threshold. This is a motivated boundary mechanism relevant to any future convergence proof, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
value.risks: Value is diagnostic/local rather than a complete convergence theorem.

final_claim: After one exact conjugate-gradient initialization step on a two-eigenmode strictly convex quadratic, the CG_AOS/Dai–Yuan step has exact distortion \(r=\mu L/(\mu^2\cos^2\theta+L^2\sin^2\theta)\), objective factor \((r-1)^2\), worst transient factor approaching \((\kappa-1)^2\), sharp scalar decrease safeguard \(0<\gamma\le 2/\kappa\), and an explicit family with \(f(x_2)/f(x_0)\sim \kappa/4\).
